Selected installed pinned toolchain is resolved directly without Elan shim; missing toolchain fails. Absolute lean.exe substitution covers both run and check_output, avoiding Windows current-directory/PATH ambiguity. Package missing artifacts fail, no automatic cache build/fetch.

Independent six focused tests passed: source identity/flags, >32 cohort parser, no-timeout adapter, absolute Lean selection including check_output, installed/missing toolchain resolver, missing upstream rejection. AST parsing passed for three Python files.

No Lean build, profiler, native Windows execution or user-computer access occurred. This is reviewed source plus mocked tests, not a verified native Windows end-to-end run or full arithmetic theorem proof.
